description: One ETFIQ benchmark in full: its rule as the methodology states it, the funds and weights in force (with SEC series ids and each fund's expense ratio and its date), and every statistic ETFIQ computes for it by window (total return, return a year, volatility, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio, turnover, factor loadings, weighted expense ratio), each with its dates and its basis. basis marks each number from before the freeze date as hypothetical. Takes an id such as etfiq-strategic-60 or strategic-60. Serves the published benchmark only; it cannot be customised.

id.description: A benchmark id, such as etfiq-strategic-60. list_benchmarks names every one.

name: get_benchmark

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
